title: State School Fund by two-year budget, billions of dollars, not adjusted for inflation
description: Bar chart of Oregon's State School Fund by two-year budget: adopted for 2023-25 and 2025-27, and the 2027-29 current service level estimate.
notes: 2027-29 is an estimate, not a budget the Legislature passed. The current service level is the Department of Administrative Services' estimate of what continuing existing programs costs [SRC:gov/press/2024_ssf-csl-proposal.html], updating the last budget for pay, benefits, pension rates, inflation and enrollment [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.111] [SRC:legislature/olis/2025R1/307212_sb5516-ssf-work-session.pdf p.2]. This one is the estimate in the Quality Education Commission's 2026 Quality Education Model report, released August 2026 [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103] [NEWS:NEWS-20260812-opb-1].
